root_cause: PC13 is configured with an IP address (172.16.12.50/24) and default gateway (172.16.12.1) that are in a different subnet than R14's connected interface (172.16.13.1/24).
verification: Run show ip interface brief on R14 to confirm interface status.
Manually verify PC13 can ping its gateway 172.16.13.1 and local hosts after the configuration change.
fix_steps: Verify the IP address and gateway configuration on PC13.
Reassign PC13 IP address to match the gateway subnet (e.g., 172.16.13.x/24).
Update PC13 default gateway address to match R14 interface IP 172.16.13.1.
Test local connectivity and gateway reachability from PC13.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: Host IP address (172.16.12.50/24) is configured in wrong subnet for gateway interface (172.16.13.1/24).
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Reassign host IP address to match gateway subnet 172.16.13.0/24.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: Configured host default gateway (172.16.12.1) does not match router interface IP (172.16.13.1).
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Update host default gateway address to 172.16.13.1.
